title: ECDICT English–Chinese dictionary

inheritedDefinitionNotice.name: WordNet 3.0
inheritedDefinitionNotice.basis: ECDICT README identifies WordNet as a contributor to its English definitions. Preserve the inherited notice alongside the ECDICT MIT licence.

fieldMeaning.ieltsTagged: The source tag field contains the separate token ielts. This is an independent dictionary tag, not IELTS endorsement or an observed examination frequency.
fieldMeaning.bncRank: The source bnc field, described by ECDICT as a British National Corpus frequency order; zero or missing is null.
fieldMeaning.contemporaryRank: The source frq field, described by ECDICT as a contemporary-corpus frequency order. The corpus identity and a measurement date are not independently established here; zero or missing is null.
fieldMeaning.phonetic: Source phonetic field, described by ECDICT as primarily British pronunciation. Apostrophe stress, colon length, legacy schwa and unambiguous legacy diphthongs are normalised; vowel quality is not guessed. The dictionary does not distinguish UK/US for every entry, and these are not individually verified UK IPA transcriptions.
fieldMeaning.forms: Explicit inflection entries from exchange keys p,d,i,3,r,t,s; no derivational stemming or fabricated frequency values.

limitations: IELTS tags are a vocabulary-selection aid and do not establish frequency in recent IELTS examinations.
General corpus ranks and the project's separately measured official public-sample counts have different populations and must not be merged into a single observed count.
The dictionary includes multiple senses and automatically derived morphology. Final context selection must check the intended sense and usable forms.
Source English sense markers are normalised for display; source Chinese glosses are lightly cleaned, not newly translated.
